en: Black‑and‑white split‑view postcard showing two buildings in Glaubitz near Riesa. The left image depicts a historic manor or small castle complex with a tall tower and attached residential wings, labeled "Schloß". The right image shows a church with a steep tiled roof, tower, and clock, partially obscured by trees, labeled "Kirche". At the bottom, in script, is the caption "Glaubitz bei Riesa".
